Skill in preparing food for consumption.
Cooking Overview
Cooking
is a trade skill that allows studied individuals to produce various regenerative foods, drinks, and other consumables. Cooked food can be consumed, or gifted to various NPCs (eg.
Marna
and
Fainor
).
Tip
: because you earn a special bonus the first time you use a recipe, don't "spam" a recipe to level up! Try to buy a variety of recipes, and make one of each. Similarly consider eating one of each foods that you cooked, for the first time bonus
Gourmand
XP.
In-Game Description
Skill in preparing food for consumption.
Training Cooking
Fainor
in
Serbule Keep
sells a large number of recipes. Most of the recipes require to be in proximity of a stove or fire pit, but not all of them (typically preparing fish and meat as a base for other recipes, can be done anywhere).
Durstin Tallow
teaches some level 3-24 recipes.
Mandibles
teaches various Casino- and mantis-themed recipes from level 30-63.
Glowing Sphere
teaches the recipes for Yeti Stick and Furpot.
Hiral
in
Sun Vale
teaches some recipes for various beverages.
Squidlips
in
Sun Vale
teaches some fish-related recipes level 25-45 and two recipes 70 & 72.
Laura Neth
teaches some level 30-45 recipes, including a level 45 snack.
Selaxi
unlocks Levels 51-60 and teaches recipes between those levels.
Nishika
teaches various cat-based recipes
Floxie
in
Fae Realm
unlocks both Levels 61-70 and 71-80 ,and teaches recipes between those levels.
Crelpin
in the
Fae Realm
teaches various recipes (mostly fruit-based) in the range of levels 61-83.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.
Connected Skills
Sub-Skills:
Sushi Preparation
- Requires Level 25 Cooking.
Related Skills:
Gardening
- Most Cooking recipes require items grown with Gardening.
Butchering
- Meat can be gathered through Butchering.
Foraging
- Fruits can be gathered through Foraging
Cheesemaking
- Cheese is sometimes needed as an ingredient.
Fishing
- There are many recipes based around fish!
